title: Incident response
description: For a service in production: roles, severity levels, preserved evidence and a blameless postmortem after a significant incident.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3, Incident Response Recommendations and Considerations for Cybersecurity Risk Management

rules.instruction: Make the incident runbook of the changed service name the incident commander role, the communications role and how to reach the on-call engineer.
rules.verification: Open the runbook and check the three entries.

rules.instruction: Ask the service owner which severity levels apply to incidents on the changed service and their response times, and record them in the runbook.
rules.verification: Check that the runbook defines each severity with its criteria and response time.

rules.instruction: During an incident, keep the timeline, decisions and links to the logs in the incident record.
rules.verification: Check that the incident record has a timeline and links to the preserved logs.

rules.instruction: After a significant incident, write a blameless postmortem with the impact, the contributing causes and action items.
rules.verification: Link the postmortem and check that each action item has an owner and a tracking issue.
